title: Definitions
description: The values that the documents of the machine adapter protocol, version 1, share. A length in characters counts Unicode code points. A validator must assert format.

version.description: The protocol version. An adapter refuses a request of any other version.

key.description: The dispatch id: dp_ and 16 characters of 0-9 and a-z without i, l, o and u. An adapter makes at most one machine for one key.

pool.description: The pool id: np_ and 16 characters of 0-9 and a-z without i, l, o and u.

size.description: A size name of the adapter's settings, 1 to 64 characters of a-z, 0-9 and -, starting with a letter.

id.description: The vendor's id for a machine, 1 to 128 ASCII characters from ! to ~. The id - alone is not a machine id.

start_data.description: The start data, 1 to 16384 bytes, as standard base64 with padding. It contains the machine's run code. A text of 21848 characters ends with ==, so that it decodes to at most 16384 bytes.

started.description: When the vendor started the machine: an RFC 3339 time in UTC, with an upper-case T and Z, and 0 to 9 digits of a second's fraction, on a date that exists.

list_state.description: The state of a listed machine: starting, running, stopped (it has stopped and still exists) or deleting.

delete_state.description: The state of a machine after a delete: deleting, or gone when it no longer exists.

log.description: The last part of the machine's console text, at most 786432 bytes as UTF-8. JSON Schema counts characters, so this schema refuses a text of more than 786432 characters, and a decoder also refuses a text of more than 786432 bytes.

kind.description: The kind of failure. limit: the vendor refused because of a limit, such as a quota. retry: a retry may clear the failure. defect: the request, the settings or the command line is wrong, so a retry fails the same way; a request with another version or an unknown member, and a make request with a size that the adapter does not know, fail with this kind. other: any other failure.

message.description: The failure for the operator, 1 to 4096 characters, starting with the fix. It never contains the start data or a secret.
